lines.text: Pixel! Pixel! Pixel!
Which side are you? Choose fast, the match won't wait.
We won! WE WON! Engineering forever! Or whoever we are!
We lost. I'm going to sit on this bench and age.
Rain? Football doesn't stop for rain! …Okay, it stopped.
This sun is playing for the other side.
Floodlights gone! Sing, so the players can find each other!
Referee! Are you watching another match?
GOAL! GOAL! …Offside? Since when?
Groundnut, two cups. One for me, one for the tension.
That striker shoots like the goalpost owes him an apology.
Number nine! Number NINE! …Ah. He's tying his laces.
Hold my drum. I'm going to advise the coach.
Last match I lost my voice. Today I brought a spare.
Drums! Louder! The other side can still hear themselves think!
Who is that keeper? He catches like a wall with hands.
Penalty! PENALTY! I didn't see it, but PENALTY!
Night match under one bulb. The ball is a rumour.
VC's Cup! First match! I don't know the rules, but I know the songs.
That fresher striker with the boots, he's good o.
Scouts in the stands! Everybody play like you're on TV!
They're showing it on the big screen at the mall. I'm loyal. I'm here.
Strike, but we still play. Ten a side. Twelve fans. Loud ones.
No referee in the strike. We're refereeing by shouting.
Our striker is limping. Ice! Somebody! Pure water!
Candidates doing laps round the pitch at half-time.
Somebody filmed the miss and it's everywhere. Leave him. He'll score.
Our striker is back! Look at him run! Give the physio a medal!
Last final for the finalists! Make it count, seniors!
Five years shouting on this stand. My voice is graduating too.
Freshers! Learn the songs first. The rules come later.
Exam week. No match. My drum is on study leave.
Passed? Come to the pitch. Failed? Also come to the pitch.
Allowance day. New boots! Old feet, new boots!
Strike? More time for five-a-side!
VC's Cup! Saturday, four o'clock! Bring your drum!
Final! Final! Who has a spare jersey? I'll wear any faculty!
Groundnut bets! Three cups on Engineering!
Candidates sponsoring jerseys. Everybody's a striker this week.
Our old captain is graduating! Lift him! Carefully!
Ramadan match after iftar! Light legs, full hearts.
Christmas match: Stayers versus Travellers. Stayers win by default.
Valentine's match. Couples on the left. Singles on the right, louder.
Harmattan match. Can't see the ball. Can see the dust.
